sn22.58:1.2: Tathāgato bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddho ti vuccati || ||
sn22.58:1.3: Bhikkhu pi bhikkhave paññāvimutto rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto paññāvimutto ti vuccati || || 4
sn22.58:2.1: Tathāgato bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vedanāya nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddhoti vuccati || ||
sn22.58:2.2: Bhikkhu pi bhikkhave paññāvimutto vedanāya nibbidā || || la || || vimutto ti vuccati || || 5-7
sn22.58:3.3: viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddho ti vuccati || ||
sn22.58:3.4: Bhikkhu pi bhikkhave paññāvimutto viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto paññāvimutto ti vuccati || || 8
sn22.58:4.1: Tatra kho bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyoso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunā ti || || 9
sn22.58:4.2: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavannettikā Bhagavampaṭisaraṇā || sādhu vata bhante Bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || ||
sn22.58:4.3: Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti ||
sn22.58:4.4: Evam bhante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 10
sn22.58:5.1: Tathāgato bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā asañjātassa maggassa sañjānetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido || ||
sn22.58:5.2: Maggānugā ca bhikkhave etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchāsamannāgatā || || 11
sn22.58:5.3: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayam adhippāyoso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunā
